<thought>Based on the provided data (C14H18OS, DBE = 6, 7 aromatic carbons, 3 methyl groups, presence of Cl, no carbonyl), a reasonable decomposition is an aromatic fragment bearing the chlorine and a methyl substituent, and an aliphatic thio‑ether fragment that supplies the remaining carbons, the sulfur, the oxygen (as an ether) and the other two methyl groups. These two fragments can be joined through a C–C bond to give a molecule that matches the overall formula and unsaturation count.</thought>
<final_answer>['Clc1ccc(C)cc1', 'CCSCC(C)C']</final_answer>
